summary.intent: Autonomously resume and drive an overnight multi-phase GSD workflow (CipherBox phases 74, 75, 77) through plan-completion and execution while the user was away, working around an earlier session-quota exhaustion.
summary.outcome: Confirmed commit debd1ff62 landed (the earlier timeout was a slow pre-commit hook, not a signing hang), verified unsigned commits won't block on 1Password, pivoted from parallel worktrees to sequential main-checkout branch switching, and launched the Phase 74 plan-completion + execution agent with a 09:45 safety-net resume scheduled as fallback.

repo: CipherBox monorepo's lint-staged pre-commit hook takes ~1-2 minutes, which can look like a hang/timeout on commit but is just slow, not stuck
commit.gpgsign=false in this repo, so autonomous/unattended commits don't block on 1Password biometric prompts
workflow: Sub-agents cannot pin into a pre-existing git worktree — EnterWorktree refuses a repo-root→worktree transition — so for sequential multi-phase work, switch branches on the main checkout instead of creating worktrees per phase

GSD's own recommended Claude Code pattern for multi-phase execution is sequential processing on a single main checkout switched per feat branch, not parallel worktrees, to avoid shared-checkout collisions
Execution across phases sharing a DB/stack must be serialized, not run concurrently
When a long-running quota-limited session might expire mid-task, schedule a safety-net resume (e.g. via ScheduleWakeup/cron) as a fallback in case the current quota window also runs out

friction: Initial commit appeared to hang/timeout, requiring investigation to distinguish a slow hook from a real signing/auth block

Overnight planner agents died mid-session due to hitting the session limit, though they left useful partial work (research/patterns/validation and draft plans) committed on their respective feat branches
Dead worktrees from the failed parallel approach had to be cleaned up before pivoting to the sequential strategy
open_items: Phase 74 plan-checker verdict and execution/verification result still pending at time of this transcript
Phases 75 and 77 still queued to run sequentially after Phase 74 completes
09:45 safety-net resume scheduled in case the current quota window runs out before phases 74/75/77 finish
